title: Introducing Muse: your personal AI agent
format_note: Music-only launch film: five short product vignettes (email, shopping, race sign-up, flight delay, calendar) joined by repeated 'AI that ... for you' title cards.
one_thing: Muse is an AI agent that does errands for you and still asks permission, so you stay in control.

transcript.voice_style: No narration. Local whisper returned only sung lyrics from the music bed; all meaning is carried by on-screen text and chat bubbles.
transcript.script_shape: Title card, then user prompt, then agent chat bubbles plus a status chip, then a result; the 'AI that ... for you' card repeats between vignettes and 'Your Muse gets it done' pays off at 68 s.

structure.frame0: Muse app icon centred on pale grey (about 21 % of frame height) with the edge of a yellow sticky note entering at left; f0001.jpg. Subject present but nearly empty (blankCells 0.919).
structure.first_3s: Icon sits still at 0.96 s while 3D objects (note, envelope, mug, pen, calendar) fly in until a full grid of about 40 objects fills the frame by 1.7 s; 'Introducing' appears at 2 s.

beats.what: App icon, then a grid of tiny 3D everyday objects fills the frame; strips/window-01-0.959s.jpg.
Title builds word by word: 'Introducing Muse', 'Muse is your personal AI agent', then 'A new kind of AI'.
Muse avatar chip, chat bubbles type in, then a prompt bar: 'Help me stay on top of school emails'.
Inbox, supply-list email, shopping list, order review, Allow/Deny permission card at 28 s.
'Done!' with check icon at 30 s, then title 'AI that books meetings for you' at 32 s.
Sleep data adjusts a training plan; Muse finds a 10k, opens a sign-up form, fills it; 'Take control of the browser' button.
Chat reply 'You're in.' then titles 'AI that tracks your goals' and 'AI that fills out forms for you'.
Muse checks weather and schedule, flight delayed card SFO to DEN, user replies 'Yes, please!', calendar tile 19 becomes 'Updated flight SFO to DEN'.
Confetti title 'Your Muse gets it done' at 68 s, then 'AI that books trips for you' and 'AI that looks out for you'.
'All in one' pill with check marks and third-party app logos (Shopify, Instagram, Messenger, others), then 'It's your Muse'.
'AI that keeps you in control' above the app icon on light ground.
Hard cut to black end card: icon, 'Muse', Google Play and App Store badges, Meta wordmark.

hero_moment.what: Confetti falls over 'Your Muse gets it done' with the avatar in a party hat (f0035.jpg); the only full-colour frame in a pale film.

ending.cta_text: AI that keeps you in control
ending.what: Light card with the claim and icon, then a 0.91 s black end card with store badges and Meta; no URL or button copy.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: Few cuts: the longest shot runs 27.67 s (17.5 to 45.17 s, 33.5 % of runtime). Pace comes from in-shot change: only 10 % of 2 s sample intervals are static and no burst of cuts exists (bursts is empty).

look.ground: Near-white to pale-blue gradient on title cards; light grey gradient behind chat scenes; black only inside the browser frame and the final end card.
look.accent_use: Blue marks 'Muse' in 'Introducing Muse' (strips/window-03-3.834s.jpg), the Allow and Submit buttons and the check icons; colour appears otherwise only in 3D emoji and confetti.
look.type: Medium-weight geometric sans, black, centred; titles 2 to 3 lines with a smaller middle line carrying an inline 3D emoji in place of an icon; UI text in a lighter grotesque.
look.depth: Soft drop shadows lift the avatar chip, prompt bar and cards off the ground; no parallax or 3D camera, only flat zooms and pans.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Push-ins crop the UI so the active line fills the frame: Submit button grows full width at 45 to 46 s, flight card and a chat bubble fill the frame at 58 to 62 s, calendar tile at 65 s.
product_ui.notes: Chat bubbles, status chip, Allow/Deny and the flight card read easily. The email body at t=20 (f0011.jpg) and form labels at t=42 are about 1.5 % of frame height and serve as texture, not as read copy.

motion.text_entry: Titles build word by word ('Introducing' to 'Muse' to 'Muse is' over about 1.3 s, strips/window-03); letters in 'Done!' step down a slant (f0016.jpg); chat bubbles type in and the 'W' bubble appears before its sentence (f0007.jpg).
motion.ui_motion: A status chip under the Muse avatar swaps its verb label ('working', 'Creating shopping list', 'Waiting for permission', 'Signing you up', 'is checking weather') every 2 to 3 s; cards slide and blur into each other.
motion.camera: Constant push-ins and pans over flat UI; no cuts inside the 27.67 s middle shot, which includes zooms at 17.5 s and 44.96 s.
motion.eases: Not measured numerically. At 17.417 to 17.5 s the prompt bar collapses to a sliver in two frames, so exits are very fast; settles on bubbles look soft.

copy.holds_vs_reading_rule: Title holds were not timed from 2 s samples. 'AI that keeps you in control' (6 words, needs 2.3 s) is visible at t=80 and cut to black at 81.67 s, so its hold is under 3.7 s.

sound.music: Music bed at 115.2 bpm (beat confidence 0.502). Describe tags: music 0.713, disc_scratching 0.518, keyboard_musical 0.383, rapping 0.371, synthesizer 0.362, singing 0.331, percussion 0.322. Whisper heard sung lines such as 'I got the sauce to make you go'.
sound.sfx: No sound effects evidenced in the measurements; I could not hear the film.
sound.vo_music_balance: No voiceover; music is the only sound (kind: music).
sound.energy_arc: Six sections: A 0 to 4.7 s, B to 13.1 s, C to 18.8 s, D to 27.2 s, E to 35.5 s, then F for the last 47 s. Integrated -16 LUFS, loudness range 5.7 LU.
sound.sync_to_picture: Cuts are not locked to the sound: 0.125 of cuts land on strong onsets against 0.17 by chance (cuts_on_strong_onset_share vs chance_share).

good.observation: One repeated title formula, 'AI that [verb phrase] for you', closes each vignette; an inline 3D emoji replaces the icon and the middle line is smaller, giving the film a chorus without voiceover.
good.evidence: f0017.jpg, f0026.jpg, f0036.jpg, f0037.jpg, f0041.jpg; six cards

good.observation: Concrete invented data makes each task checkable on sight: $47.80 total, SFO to DEN 2h 30m, 2:15 PM to 5:45 PM, 'Autumn Trail 10K Entry Form'.
Permission is shown on screen before the 'in control' claim is made: Deny/Allow at 28 s and 'Take control of the browser / Stop the task' at 44 s, so the closing line is already proved.
A small avatar chip with a changing verb label gives the viewer a single anchor across all vignettes, and the label acts as narration.
Push-in transitions are caused by content: prompt bar collapses into the inbox, form zooms to the Submit button, calendar tile becomes the result card.
Colour is held back for the payoff: confetti and the party-hat avatar are the only saturated full-frame moment, at 82 % of runtime.

weak.observation: The email body and form labels are about 1.5 % of frame height, unreadable at phone width, so the supply-list payload is not actually read.
The end card is on screen 0.91 s with store badges about 20 px wide; the call to action is too short and small to act on.
Frame 0 is a lone app icon on a nearly blank field (blankCells 0.919); the subject does not do anything until objects arrive at 1.1 s.
Cuts are not tied to the music: 12.5 % of cuts sit on strong onsets against 17 % chance.

rule_candidates.rule: Without voiceover, repeat one title template ('AI that ___ for you') between product vignettes, with an inline emoji standing in for the key noun; six repeats gave the film its structure.
A film can run 8 hard cuts in 82.6 s (median shot 4.75 s) if something on screen changes in at least 90 % of 2 s intervals through camera push-ins and UI state changes.
Show consent controls (Allow/Deny, 'Take control', 'Stop the task') on screen before a trust claim is made, then state the claim as the closing line.
Label the agent's current action in a chip that changes every 2 to 3 s, using one present-tense verb phrase each, to narrate a silent product film.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0012.jpg 'working', f0013.jpg 'Creating shopping list', f0022.jpg 'Signing you up'

rule_candidates.rule: An energetic music film need not have a cut burst: this one has none (bursts empty) and puts its hero at 0.82 of runtime, with colour as the peak instead of cut density.
UI used only as texture may fall below 2.6 % type height if the same fact returns as large chat text within 2 s; a 1.5 % email body precedes a restating bubble.
A -16 LUFS integrated mix with -14.3 LUFS short-term peak and -3.1 dBTP stays within the true-peak limit but sits 2 LU under the social loudness target; master to -14 explicitly.
Close on the claim card for at least 2 s before any end card; here the badge card lasts 0.91 s and its badges are about 20 px wide.

unchecked: Sound was not heard; instruments and lyrics are inferred from audio.json tags and whisper output only.
Native-rate holds for title cards were not timed; 2 s samples only, so most hold_s are -1.
Ink measure at t=76 and t=8 returned the whole ROI (grey gradient counted as ink), so 'It's your Muse' and 'A new' sizes are unmeasured.
Title heights include ascenders and descenders; 'Introducing' (12.6 %) includes the descender of 'g'.
Product UI presence share (52 %) is estimated from the sheets' 2 s samples.
